purpose: Preserve source-private, role-conditioned high-dimensional evidence in shadow bridge tokens, then inject only those bridge states into an otherwise untouched joint forward pass.
failure_model: P014 showed that isolating the main stream destroys useful global evidence, while P035 showed that reducing each source to a scalar before composition loses useful joint evidence. P038 improved order stability but its binding contrast did not discriminate positives. SBB keeps the global stream and introduces a narrow high-dimensional private path before joint reasoning.

literature_grounding.primitive: Private bridge-token paths can bind instances while the main stream retains global composition.
literature_grounding.transfer_delta: Use source-private bridge states for discriminative multi-reference retrieval rather than image generation.

literature_grounding.primitive: A small layer/token subset can carry causally important visual information.
literature_grounding.transfer_delta: Screen preregistered layer windows instead of modifying all visual tokens or all layers.

literature_grounding.work: Mechanisms of Object Localization (CVPR 2026) and Visual Retrieval Heads (arXiv:2608.27417)
literature_grounding.primitive: Visual grounding is concentrated in a small causal subset of model computation.
literature_grounding.transfer_delta: Test whether narrow bridge injection improves binding evidence without erasing the joint stream.

literature_grounding.primitive: Matched wrong binding separates source confusion from ordinary degradation.
literature_grounding.transfer_delta: Select a layer window only when correct-minus-wrong binding separates positives from explicit negatives.

innovation_boundary: Bridge tokens, masked attention, causal activation intervention, and multi-vector representations are prior art.
The candidate delta is a training-free retrieval intervention that caches source-private role anchors and injects them into an intact joint multi-reference forward pass.
P039 is a selected development mechanism screen. A pass would justify only a prospective component-disjoint P040 pilot, not a novelty or SOTA claim.

prompt_protocol.shared_instruction: Judge whether the candidate jointly satisfies both source-local requirements.
prompt_protocol.source_block: Each role requirement is placed immediately before its attached reference image.
prompt_protocol.correct_ab: Role A with reference A, then Role B with reference B.
prompt_protocol.equivalent_ba: Role B with reference B, then Role A with reference A; semantics unchanged.
prompt_protocol.wrong_binding_ba: Role A with reference B, then Role B with reference A; image order matches equivalent_ba.
prompt_protocol.shadow_path: Block every token after the first bridge from attending to the first reference image or first bridge until the second bridge is formed.
prompt_protocol.joint_path: Keep the original causal mask and replace only bridge-marker hidden states in the preregistered layer window.

selection_rule.eligible: A non-control window must pass every development gate.
selection_rule.all_layer_control: If bridge_all_layers has binding AUC greater than or equal to the selected narrow window, stop rather than selecting a window.

development_gate.binding_contrast_macro_auc: strictly greater than 0.55 and at least soft + 0.05
development_gate.all_layer_control: binding AUC strictly below the selected narrow window
development_gate.meaning: Eligibility to design P040 on frozen, component-disjoint observed data; no full-scale or held-out access.

limits: The same ten observed development queries used by P038 are reused for a mechanism screen.
Only 18 positives and 16 explicit negatives are scored; uncertainty is high and no confirmatory claim is allowed.
Layer windows are coarse and chosen only by the frozen rule.
No reserved or held-out component may be accessed in P039.
Any later full-scale run requires a separate prospective pilot whose frozen gates all pass.
